# SEO Agentic

FAMILY SYSTEM: this skill is one folder of the claude-seo plugin family; its bundled tools, launcher (scripts/claude-seo at the repository root) and sibling seo-* skills live outside this folder, so a standalone copy lacks them. It audits and drafts fixes for a site's readiness for AI browsing agents: the Lighthouse Agentic Browsing X/N fraction (via the PageSpeed Insights API), accessibility tree, robots.txt/Content-Signal, llms.txt, Markdown delivery, discovery files and WebMCP. Its scripts fetch the target URL over the network; the WAF user-agent matrix runs only with the user's authorisation; fix mode drafts to stdout only, refresh mode updates its own dated references. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions.
